Gold Seller Leads Atlanta

CaratBase connects independent jewellers in Atlanta with verified local gold sellers, appraisal seekers, and engagement ring buyers. The first three leads are free, then only $40 per accepted lead.

What you get

• First 3 leads free • $40 per accepted lead • Optional valuation widget $29/month

Why CaratBase

Leads are pre‑screened to ensure they are ready to sell or buy, reducing wasted outreach. Our Atlanta launch guarantees local relevance and quick follow‑up.

FAQ

How are the leads verified? We confirm each prospect’s intent through a short questionnaire and phone verification before delivering the lead.

Can I cancel the valuation widget anytime? Yes, the $29/month widget can be paused or cancelled with no penalty after the current billing cycle.

Next step: Sign up now to claim your free leads and start growing your Atlanta jewellery business.
